name: save-delta-e2e-single-table-probe
body: The pre-save mark set is read from the `Constraint` table alone — the fixture's only durable node table — while the post-save drain is measured through `dirty_node_files_from_db`, which walks the full 15-table roster; add a multi-table fixture if a per-table pre-save mark probe is ever wanted. The drain assertion also has to release the session first (`ArtifactDb::open` after `session end`) because the session holds the database flock, so the two halves are observed through different handles by design.
